# ScreenHarmony Flex v2.9.0

### 🚀 Highlights & Major Features

#### ⏰ Exact Alarms & Schedule Automation (Android 12–14+)
- **Exact Alarm Permission Handling**: Fully integrated `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` support with Android 12–14+ compatibility checks (`canScheduleExactAlarms()`).
- **Resilient Fallback Mechanism**: Graceful automatic fallback to windowed and inexact alarms if exact alarm permissions are restricted by the OS.
- **Permission State Change Receiver**: Listens for `ACTION_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM_PERMISSION_STATE_CHANGED` to automatically reschedule all active block schedules the instant permissions are granted.
- **Schedule Watchdog Alarms**: Added robust background watchdog checks to preserve schedule accuracy across reboots and Doze cycles.

#### 🛡️ Multi-OEM Anti-Tamper Shield
- **Expanded OEM System Coverage**: Added targeted interception for security suites, package managers, and settings managers across **Xiaomi (HyperOS/MIUI Security Center)**, **Oppo/Realme (Phone Manager)**, **Vivo (iManager)**, and **Huawei (System Manager)**.
- **Uninstallation & Force-Stop Guards**: Prevent malicious bypass, settings tampering, and unauthorized app removal.

#### 🔋 OEM Autostart & Notification Resilience
- **Play Store Compliant Multi-OEM Settings Navigation**: Direct deep-linking to autostart and background battery management for top Android manufacturers.
- **Android 13+ Runtime Notification Handling**: Clean runtime `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` permission flow for persistent background protection alerts.

#### 📡 Remote Wake-Up & Parent Telemetry
- **Proactive Remote Wake-Up**: Automatically transmits wake signals before locking offline child devices.
- **1-Minute Freshness Check**: Skips redundant wake-up sequences when child devices are already active and connected.
- **Parent Feedback & Failure Alerts**: Real-time signal indicators for online connectivity and instant contextual error dialogs.

---

### ⚙️ CI/CD & Build Infrastructure
- **GitHub Actions Automated Pipeline**: Continuous integration with automated unit tests and dual-flavor release APK/Bundle compilation.
- **Automated Tag & Release System**: Integrated release notes parsing and multi-channel artifact distribution.
